description: Add WAL Protocol (Write-Ahead Logging) section to AGENTS.md for capturing corrections, decisions, and critical details before responding
steps: Open ~/.openclaw/workspace/AGENTS.md
Find 'Memory Architecture' section (around line 200)
Add new section '## WAL Protocol (Write-Ahead Logging)' after Memory Architecture, before Solvr Integration
Add intro: 'Chat history is a BUFFER, not storage. Write critical details to daily notes BEFORE responding.'

Add trigger list: corrections ('It's X not Y', 'Actually...', 'No, I meant...'), proper nouns (names, places, companies), preferences ('I like/don't like'), decisions ('Let's do X', 'Use Z'), specific values (numbers, dates, IDs, URLs)
Add rule: 'If ANY trigger appears in human message: STOP → Write to memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md under ## Session State → THEN respond'
Add rationale: 'The urge to respond is the enemy. Context vanishes. Write first.'
Add example block showing WRONG ('Got it!') vs RIGHT (write first, then respond)
Create daily notes template section: add '## Session State' heading to memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md template pattern
Verify: section reads clearly, ~20-30 lines max

description: Create security-audit.sh script for automated security checks on workspace credentials, secrets, and configuration
steps: Create ~/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/security-audit.sh
Add shebang (#!/bin/bash), set +e, color helpers (RED, YELLOW, GREEN, NC)
Add warn(), fail(), pass() helper functions with colored output
Add check 1: credential file permissions - scan ~/.openclaw/ and .credentials/ for files, verify 600 perms
Add check 2: secret patterns - grep *.md *.json for (api_key|token|password|secret)=.{10,} excluding example/placeholder/TODO
Add check 3: gateway loopback - grep ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json for 'loopback' in gateway.bind
Add check 4: AGENTS.md security rules - grep for 'injection|external content|never execute'
Add check 5: pre-commit hooks - check if ~/clawd/.git/hooks/pre-commit exists
Add check 6: gitignore - verify .credentials and .env in .gitignore
Add summary: echo issues/warnings count, exit 0 if clean, exit 1 if issues
chmod +x the script
Test: run ./scripts/security-audit.sh, verify it completes and shows summary
Update HEARTBEAT.md: add 'Security audit (weekly): ./scripts/security-audit.sh' to rotation

description: Add 'Verify Implementation, Not Intent' principle to AGENTS.md to prevent text-only changes that don't affect behavior
steps: Open ~/.openclaw/workspace/AGENTS.md
Find 'Self-Improvement Workflow' section (around line 248)
Add new subsection '### Verify Implementation, Not Intent' after the workflow description
Add principle: 'Text changes ≠ behavior changes. When modifying how something works, check the MECHANISM (config values like sessionTarget, code paths, actual tool calls), not just the prompt text.'
Add failure mode example: 'Changed cron prompt to say "do the work" but kept sessionTarget: main and kind: systemEvent → still just prompts, doesn't execute'
Add rule: 'After changing how something works, verify by observing actual behavior, not just reading the config'
Verify: subsection is 5-10 lines max, actionable

description: Add Cron Job Architecture section to AGENTS.md documenting when to use systemEvent vs isolated agentTurn
steps: Open ~/.openclaw/workspace/AGENTS.md
Find appropriate location after 'Token Efficiency' section or before 'Make It Yours'
Add new section '## Cron Job Architecture'
Add intro: 'Know when to use systemEvent (prompts main session) vs isolated agentTurn (executes autonomously)'
Add markdown table with columns: Type, sessionTarget, payload.kind, When to Use, Example
Row 1: Prompted | main | systemEvent | Need human/main session attention | Reminders, alerts, questions
Row 2: Autonomous | isolated | agentTurn | Background work without attention | Status checks, maintenance, file updates
Add rule: 'If work should happen WITHOUT main session attention → use isolated agentTurn with full instructions'
Add failure mode: 'systemEvent saying "check X" while main session is busy → prompt sits there, nothing happens'
Verify: section is clear decision framework, ~15-20 lines

description: Add lightweight ADL (Anti-Drift Limits) principles as Evolution Guardrails to Self-Improvement section in AGENTS.md
steps: Open ~/.openclaw/workspace/AGENTS.md
Find 'Self-Improvement Workflow' section (around line 248)
Add new subsection '### Evolution Guardrails' after the existing content
Add intro: 'When evolving your own operating system, apply these constraints:'
Add bullet: '**Stability > Novelty** — don't break working things for shiny new approaches'
Add bullet: '**No complexity theater** — reject changes that look smart but add no real value'
Add bullet: '**Verifiable only** — if you can't test that it worked, don't do it'
Add bullet: '**Compound leverage** — optimize for future-you solving more problems with less cost'

Verify: subsection is ~10 lines, principles are memorable

description: Create checkpoint-verify.sh script to test that last checkpoint is recoverable (VBR for AMCP checkpoints)
steps: Create ~/.openclaw/skills/proactive-amcp/scripts/checkpoint-verify.sh
Add shebang, set -e, source config.sh for shared variables
Step 1: Read last CID from ~/.amcp/last-checkpoint.json using jq
Step 2: Fetch checkpoint from IPFS (use ipfs cat or curl gateway)
Step 3: Source checkpoint-decrypt.sh (like resuscitate.sh does) for decryption functions
Step 3b: Use is_checkpoint_encrypted() and decrypt_checkpoint() functions from sourced script
Step 4: Verify identity.json exists and AID matches current ~/.amcp/identity.json
Step 5: Verify MEMORY.md or workspace files are readable
Step 6: Output success: '✅ Checkpoint QmXYZ verified recoverable (identity OK, memory OK)'
Step 7: Output failure with specific error if any step fails
Add --quick flag for lightweight check (just decrypt, skip full content verify)
chmod +x the script
Test: run checkpoint-verify.sh, verify it passes on recent checkpoint
Test: corrupt a test checkpoint, verify script detects failure

description: Create solvr-verify.sh script to verify Solvr posts match what was intended (VBR for Solvr)
steps: Create ~/.openclaw/skills/proactive-amcp/scripts/solvr-verify.sh
Add shebang, set -e, load SOLVR_API_KEY from config
Accept argument: resource type (problem, approach, idea) and ID
GET the resource from Solvr API: curl https://api.solvr.dev/v1/{type}s/{id}
For approaches: verify status field matches expected (working, succeeded, failed)
For problems: verify title and description are non-empty
For ideas: verify tags and description present
Output: '✅ Solvr {type} {id} verified: status={status}, title={title}'
Output failure if resource not found or fields missing
Add --json flag for machine-readable output
chmod +x the script
Test: run solvr-verify.sh approach <recent-approach-id>, verify output
